text:
jamie: Heads up — we saw a routing surge at ~07:42 UTC. A large number of priority-tier EU requests were sent to us-east after the route-migration job. Some tenants reported 800/504 spikes. :eyes:
sasha: Confirmed. I see a batch of route rebinds in the migration logs. Looks like the 'priority_prefer_region' flag flipped during the rollout, then got rolled back but some inflight bindings got stuck.
jamie: Logs (snip):
```json
{"tenant":"acme-corp","route":"/v1/generate","from":"eu-west-1","to":"us-east-1","variant":"gptq-8b-q3","reason":"migration:pref_flip"}
```
nora: Is this tied to the variant compatibility gating we added yesterday? We deployed a compat shim that downgrades variants when families mismatch.
ale: Yep. The compat shim responds with a compatibility fallback token (like a 302) which the router interprets as 're-dispatch'. Combined with the migration flip, this created lots of cross-region reissues.
jamie: We're observing what I'm calling a "downgrade cascade" — EU→US routing, US capacity saturates, then US starts redirecting to aux EU, which trips quota gates and produces a loop for a subset of tenants.
kai: Can we temporarily pin priority-tier tenants to their origin region while we fix the migration flag? Quick hot-fix: set tenant_route_pin=true for affected tenant IDs. :hammer:
sasha: deploy-bot: route-migration-v2 started by @ops at 07:40 UTC; paused at 07:43 UTC; resumed at 07:44 UTC — that narrow window seems correlated with the spike.
deploy-bot: route-migration-v2 status: resumed -> monitoring.
nora: I pushed a targeted hotpatch to routing-service: set fallback_retention=30s to reduce re-dispatch churn and increased loop-detection sensitivity. That should break short cycles.
jamie: Can we add two quick telemetry metrics to the console: `route_rebind_count` and `variant_redirect_chain_length` (per-tenant) — SRE needs to triage this from the UI without paging logs.
devex-bot: created ticket CONSOLE-482: add `route_rebind_count` and `variant_redirect_chain_length` to tenant dashboard; assigned to @devex.
ale: Action items: (1) Add a cross-region circuit-breaker for priority tier that fails fast instead of reissuing more redirects, (2) expose a read-only pin toggle in console for SRE to opt tenants out of migration, (3) change compat shim to annotate fallbacks with `sticky=false` so router doesn't treat them as permanent rewrites.
jamie: For now I'm going to bulk-pin 5 affected tenants and open an RCA. I'll include traffic graphs and the migration job timeline in the postmortem. Thanks everyone — will update once pins are live. :white_check_mark:
